As of December 2014, the common driver for this device :''does not support monitor mode'' on Linux.
==Additional external links== ===Forum posts=== *[http://foro.seguridadwireless.net/adaptadores-wireless-usb/alfa-network-awus036nhv-con-chipset-rtl8188eus/ Presumed legit images @ '''foro.seguridadwireless.net'''] :FCC ID: 2AB8F36V, "AWUS036NHV V011" and a date code of '''1416''' :is silkscreened on the board shown. :The 2AB8F grantee code belongs to [http://szqunsuo.com/ '''Shenzhen Qunsuo Technology'''], :a company which seems to manufacture thermal printers. :The FCC ID '''2AB8F36V''' doesn't seem to appear in the FCC database, however, :FCC ID '''2AB878188''' does.. and it is listed as belonging to the AWUS036NHV. *[http://forum.antichat.ru/threadedpost3732360.html Presumed legit images of the 036NHV's board @ '''forum.antichat.ru'''] :"AWUS036NHV V011" and a date code of '''1416''' is silkscreened on the board shown.
